title: What a Star Timelapse Actually Teaches You About Gear
excerpt: The iOptron SkyTracker Pro did its job — then a loose ball head sent it swinging, and it barely mattered. The takeaway from a night under New Mexico's new moon: your star timelapse needs less gear than you think.

title: How to Edit Autumn Foliage Without Overcooking It
excerpt: Pit Haupert leaves the global saturation slider alone entirely. His autumn foliage workflow: texture up, clarity around minus 20, per-color mixer work, and RGB curves for warm highlights over cool shadows.

title: You Don't Need a Fiery Sunset to Make a Great Landscape Photo
excerpt: Craig Roberts has stopped chasing epic light. His case: the pleasant, ordinary scenes near your door — shot often, learned deeply — make stronger photographers than one trip a year to a famous viewpoint.
